scope: Supplemental original numerical certificate completion for one exact high count. Mathematical source/inputs/candidate/algorithms/parameters unchanged. Not full finite Ramanujan completion.

phases.policy: Independently rehash source/snapshots/compiler/context/object/receipt/logs and exact types/axioms of ALL696 accepted generated modules. Validate current accepted generic checker/correctness sources and their actual proof closure. A partial ledger grants no final success.

phases.dispatch_policy: Reserve actual cap BEFORE future submit. Current MemAvailable must be >=1TiB and >=512GiB+ALL current reservations including proposed dispatch; CPU must be in allowed affinity. Recheck at every dispatch and poll.
phases.poll_guard_policy_requested_for_review: If threshold becomes false while valid workers already run, pause NEW dispatch, record guard event and let useful active proofs drain; reevaluate before resuming. No claim that an unmet guard held and no automatic kill of valid proofs.

phases.independent_audit: Fresh controller-generated Lean verifies EVERY2768 exact chunk fact type and empty axioms; exact GapCheck type and empty axioms; entries_checked type; exact actual Nat prime-count theorem with standard-three-only closure.

failure_policy: Preserve all outcomes/artifacts. Drain and record every already-active success/failure on any worker failure, then halt new dispatch. Distinguish address-space allocation failure, actual OS OOM kill, execution failure and mathematical/kernel rejection. No source/candidate substitution; resource-only retry needs exact same hashes and separate receipts.
reporting: Record actual per-worker GNUtime wall/peakRSS, source/object hashes, exact RLIMIT_AS, actualPIDs/starttokens, sampled process-tree RSS/PSS/virtual/VmPeak and disk. Reservedvirtualcaps are not actualRAM. Report this campaign separately from published phase1; do not retroactively relabel outcomes.
final_gate: No theorem success until every original chunk+GapCheck+Final and independent actual Nat prime-count type/axiom audit pass. Source-first C PV numerical instance can then be separately instantiated and audited; no global3.5m count-site completion is claimed.
